profile.headline: Software Engineer at Aruba, a Hewlett Packard Enterprise
profile.summary:
As a senior at the University of the Pacific, majoring in Computer Engineering, I have a GPA of 3.82.  
Below is a summary of my education and skill set.  
Courses: 
-Digital Design
-Advanced Circuits
-Computer Architecture
-Micro-controllers
-Programming Languages
-Robotics
-Web Applications 

Projects: 
-Switch Port Security – created test environment to investigate port access security issue on
an HPE/Aruba switch and worked with multiple teams to resolve the issue
-Unit testing – wrote Ceedling tests to improve code coverage and ensure correctness of code
-Micro-controller: constructed an MP3 player by programming in C and MIPS and adding interface hardware to a TM4C1294 platform
-Sensors – assisted researcher by designing and programming an accelerometer for lightweight, low-cost soil sensor for UAV deployment
-Processor – designed and implemented a processor in System Verilog 
-Robot – designed a robot that used low-level interfaces to transfer sensor data from a TM4C123 platform to a Raspberry Pi using C and Python, to drive the robot through a maze

Skills: 
-C/C++
-Python
-SystemVerilog
-Matlab

Work Experience: 
-Embedded Software Engineer Intern: Investigated bug reports in Layer 2 Switching Firmware.  Submitted code to fix bugs.  Developed tests to check code.  Created features for the command line and logging to help discover bugs
-Office Assistant: work with administrative staff to organize, deliver, and complete files
-SOECS Tutor: Assist Engineering and Computer Science students with concepts and assignments by answering questions, explaining the material, and communicating positive feedback.  Courses include: Calculus, Digital Design, and Matlab
